brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: One full hex base (piece) closed with a solid top cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top) and six solid end caps on all side bearings (cap:0,0,0;*;30 through ;330), lockJoints applied. check_build: no issues, meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: A louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: A louvre port (port:0#0,0#0, hex-port-louvre, slot 0) was added and the build passes check_build. However, capOpenFaces then capped all six side bearings and the port's exact face could not be confirmed (it is not visible to the look tool and the build offers side caps at every bearing), so I cannot verify the vent is actually open to air. Re-check the port's face position before relying on it.
The configurator checks fit and collisions only; it does not model airflow. Vent placement and airflow are unverified.

finish.summary: Built a single closed hex enclosure: full base, solid top cover, six solid side caps, with a louvre port added on slot 0. The configurator reports no issues and a clear mesh check. The vent's placement is not verified: the cap pass closed all six side bearings and the port's face could not be located with the tools available, so the louvre may be covered. No airflow or material claims are verified.
